trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash - NullPointerException in media picker callback when app is backgrounded mid-upload. Top crasher ~4% of Android sessions. Repro: start photo upload, background app before finish, return. Owner to fix and verify by Wednesday for QA before release. Sam to confirm on Android 14 test devices and add to regression run.

trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: Implement backend sync API for offline notes list - enterprise customer promise. Endpoint accepts client last-synced timestamp and returns delta of created, updated, deleted notes. Conflict resolution last-write-wins, no merge UI this pass. Owner Elena, needs to be in review before out on 17th-18th.

trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: Implement client-side offline support for notes list. Local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay on connectivity restore. Acceptance: app usable in airplane mode, notes visible and editable, reconciliation on reconnect with no data loss. Owner Marcus.

trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Proof of concept for build job exists. Finish test and release pipelines this sprint, keep nightly build schedule, run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins. Keep Jenkins alive until parallel week is clean. Owner Sam.

trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint after incident. Limit 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded. Add metrics counter to identify users hitting limit. Owner Elena.

trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: Update privacy consent screen for GDPR compliance - EU launch blocker for Aug 20 release. Get new copy from legal and rebuild screen with opt-in toggles for analytics and marketing separately, no pre-checked boxes. Consent must be opt-in. Owner Marcus, due for Aug 20 release.

trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: Write automated regression tests for payments flow. Coverage for purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation path. Tests must run in CI as part of new GitHub Actions pipeline. Owner Sam.

trello.name: MeetingTask
trello.desc: QA verification of Android crash fix. Confirm fix on Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands fix, add to regression run. Owner Sam, due by Wednesday to allow QA time before Aug 20 release.
